preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n + 1 lines: the first line is the integer n, followed by n lines of polyhedron names.
The number of polyhedrons n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(name in ['Tetrahedron', 'Cube', 'Octahedron', 'Dodecahedron', 'Icosahedron'] for name in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines contains exactly one of the five valid polyhedron names.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(faces_map[name] for name in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:])
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of faces for all polyhedrons, where Tetrahedron=4, Cube=6, Octahedron=8, Dodecahedron=12, Icosahedron=20.
